requirements_summary: Mid-market SaaS for product analytics. Primary workload: interactive chat assistant embedded in product UI plus document search and reranking for support docs. Latency targets: p95 <= 120ms for short-turn chat (user-visible), tail requirements for session continuity; throughput expected ~40-80 qps during peak. Cost sensitivity: mid-market buyer needs clear TCO comparison hosted vs Dedicated (3yr reserved). Prefer open model variants for cost/quality tradeoffs; willing to accept quantized/8-bit variants as fallback. Must support EU data residency (primary), option for multi-region routing (EU primary, NA fallback) with configurable routing policy. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching, cache TTL, and quantization profiles to hit cost targets.
notes:
Summary:
- Prospect: Helix Nimbus Software — product analytics SaaS (B2B). Evaluating Redwood Hosted API first, then Dedicated reserved capacity for EU region if POC satisifes latency and residency needs.
Recent timeline and activities:
- 2025-11-12: initial inbound sign-up, sandbox keys issued. (AE: Sofia)
- 2026-01-22: discovery call — discussed workloads, typical session length, and token budgets. Fireflies: ff_2026-02-14_helixnimbus_demo_324.
- 2026-02-14: demo of Hosted API (Sofia + Liam). Good reception on streaming/chat and per-route analytics. Follow-up: request for EU latency numbers and cost model.
- 2026-02-28: sent pricing deck (drive:/Redwood/pricing/helixnimbus-pricing-deck-v2.pdf) and security FAQ.
- 2026-03-03: security review kickoff with Helix SecOps. Provided SOC2 scope and SSO/SAML flow. Jira SEC-1199 opened for KMS questions.
- 2026-03-08: deep dive on data residency and routing with platform team (SE: Liam). Fireflies: ff_2026-03-08_security_review_441. Demo notes: they need EU-only storage for customer PII and the ability to route traffic to NA as fallback but prefer EU latency for EU customers.
- 2026-03-09: pricing negotiation call; asked forDedicated EU node pricing for 3-month POC and annual reserved terms. Gmail thread g/CA+thread+HNX-3452 contains the pricing exchange.
POC scope (proposed):
- 4-week POC using Hosted API with EU-backed region (test traffic from Frankfurt region).
- Baseline metric collection: p50/p95 latency, tokens per session, cost per 1k tokens.
- If Hosted meets latency and residency constraints, move to 3-month Dedicated trial with reserved GPUs in EU (can scale to multi-region in later phase).
Requirements & decision criteria (customer stated):
- Must demonstrate EU data residency (data at rest and logs stored in EU KMS).
- p95 chat latency <= 120ms for baseline 8k token sessions. Accept higher latency for long-context calls but must have fallback policy.
- Clear cost comparison: hosted vs dedicated with projected 12-month volumes. Need modeled savings >= 25% to justify Dedicated.
- Support for SSO/SAML and audit logging for compliance.
- Model routing policy: EU-first, NA-fallback; prefer session-stickiness to region.
Notes from SE (Liam):
- Quick wins: prefix KV caching and session pinning likely to bring p95 down by ~20–30ms for chat. Recommend starting with quantized 4/8-bit model variant for non-sensitive workloads to reduce token cost.
- Tradeoffs discussed: Dedicated in EU reduces latency and gives residency guarantees but increases reserved commit and provisioning lead time (3–6 weeks). Hosted API with EU provisioning can be faster but needs contract terms for residency SLA.
Open questions / blockers:
- Exact legal wording for data residency in contract (customer legal needs EU-only clause).
- Dedicated pricing for 3-month POC and annualized reserved commit.
- Monitoring retention period options for logs in EU (they want 1 year).
Next steps (action items):
- Redwood: provide Dedicated EU POC pricing and template contract clause for EU data residency by 2026-03-15. (Owner: Sofia)
- SE: prepare technical runbook for POC including KV caching suggestions and routing config examples (Owner: Liam).
- Customer: confirm pilot tenants and traffic profile for 4-week Hosted POC by 2026-03-16.
- Schedule POC kickoff meeting: 2026-03-20 (tentative).

- "We need to keep EU customer data in the EU — no exceptions for logs" — Head of Security, Helix Nimbus.
- "If Dedicated saves us >25% annual, sign up — otherwise stay hosted" — VP Product, Helix Nimbus.
